name: APS Innovation Co., Ltd.
summary: DE&T Co., Ltd. focuses on designing and manufacturing both components and machinery for flat panel displays. Their product offerings comprise a range of specialized devices, including bulb testers, systems for macro and micro-level inspection, agent application equipment, bin sorters, and module testing units. The company conducts its operations across two principal divisions: Secondary Battery and Display. Established on August 1, 2001, the firm's corporate headquarters are situated in Osan-si, South Korea.
